_note: Live trade-zone settings for the STOCK bot (owner 2026-10-14: live, forward-tested). The 2-hour optimizer edits this file (values only within the frozen grid), then deploys. intraday = ab- scalp/day bot, swing = sw- bot.

ladder._note: owner 2026-10-14 (drawing): buy once risking 1% of equity (the stop = the 'All' line); against the trade sell 25% half way to the stop and 50% in all at three quarters, the stop takes the rest; in the take-profit zone sell 25% at the zone (stop to break-even) and 50% in all 0.25 ATR beyond (stop locked at the zone); the rest rides the trend (expert's fixed target off). Repeats while the stock trends (up to 3 trades per stock per day). The riding part is followed by a virtual stop 1 ATR behind its best price.
ladder._note_by_expert: owner 2026-10-16: every TREND expert uses its own philosophy's zones: take-profit steps, stop locks and trail from engine.EXPERT_LADDERS, one hard stop (its sell zone, no cut steps); buy / take-profit zone distances in profiles.<expert> (engine.EXPERT_ZONES). Range experts and the box strategies keep the drawn plan.

mtf._note: owner 2026-10-15: trend direction AND strength confirmed on weekly / 1-hour / 15-minute before entry, and re-checked while the trade runs (the 1-hour trend turning against a trend-expert trade exits it at the next open). Range experts need a NON-trending 1-hour market. Set entry / trend_exit to false to switch a part off.

box._note: owner 2026-10-16: the range box as its own strategy, LIVE without waiting for the test (paper). Weinstein stage, direction and multi-timeframe checks apply as for every expert; buy zone = bottom third of the daily box, stop 0.5 daily ATR outside it, take-profit = far edge less 0.25 daily ATR, cuts and TP steps as drawn. Set live to false to switch it off.

fib._note: owner 2026-10-16: the range box with Fibonacci zones, LIVE on paper at reduced size without a backtest (his decision). Buy zone 0.618-0.786 retracement of the daily box, stop 0.25 daily ATR beyond the box edge, TP1 at the 0.5 level, TP2 at the 0.236 level, drawn cuts and rider. risk_pct = share of equity risked per trade (0.005 = 0.5%, half the normal 1%). Set live to false to switch it off.

hybrid._note: owner 2026-10-16: HYBRID zones (range box + Fibonacci levels + the stock's swing levels; the entry is where they agree), LIVE on paper at reduced size without a backtest (his decision). Rules in zonemap.HYBRID_RULES; stop 0.5 ATR past the entry level, TP1 the first target >= 1R, TP2 the next >= 0.5R beyond. Tag hybrid_box. Set live to false to switch it off.

box_confirm._note: owner 2026-10-16 ('fix the box: candlesticks, volume, volatility'): a close outside the stock's daily box is traded WITH the break only when the continuation indicators agree (body, close location, volume >= 1.5x, volatility >= 1.1x, decisive close; vote = share that must agree). The fade side lost in every test, so mode = continuation. LIVE on paper at half size by the owner's decision. Set live to false to switch it off.

trend_confirm._note: owner 2026-10-16: trend experts (velez_elephant, raschke_grail, brooks_pullback, donchian_turtle) enter only when the signal bar shows the trend continuing: at least `vote` of 5 checks agree (body, close location, volume >= vol_mult x 20-bar avg, volatility >= session average, follow-through past the previous bar). A filter only: it removes entries, never adds them. Set live to false to switch it off.

risk_by_expert._note: 2026-10-16 expert breakdown (last 3 months, each expert alone through the live setup, two halves): these lost in BOTH halves and make ~90% of the trades - halved to 0.5% risk under the owner's live-paper rule (live results decide; restore 0.01 or switch off later). velez_180 PF 0.42/0.38 (212 trades), williams_r 0.46/0.60 (409), dual_regime 0.43/0.38 (241), connors_rsi2 0.30/0.81 (187), vwap_dev 0.77/0.54 (266), opening_range_breakout 0.10/0.11 (20), donchian_turtle 0.55/0.11 (21).

reversal_confirm._note: owner 2026-10-16: mean-reversion experts (connors_rsi2, bollinger_bounce, williams_r, vwap_dev, velez_180) enter only when the move against them is FAILING: at least `need` of 4 checks (reversal candle incl. Velez's bottoming tail and 180; the last 3 bars show no strong continuation against the trade; 5-minute ATR <= vola_max x session average; Velez's rubber band: stretched >= stretch_atr ATR from the 20 EMA). A filter only. Set live to false to switch it off.

regime_switch._note: owner 2026-10-16: mean-reversion experts (connors_rsi2, bollinger_bounce, williams_r, vwap_dev, velez_180) enter only while SPY's daily ADX (14, completed days) is below adx_max = the market is ranging. Box strategies and trend experts are not affected. A filter only; set live to false to switch it off.

trend_stairs._note: owner's trend_stairs drawing 2026-10-17 (brain.TrendStairsSignals): only while the 15-minute and 1-hour trends agree (plus direction first / Weinstein stage); buy the pullback when `need` of 4 agree (at the 20 MA, holding VWAP, 5-minute stochastic crosses up, 1-hour stochastic <= h1_stoch_max); stop stop_atr ATR under the 20 MA; TP1 +tp1_atr ATR, TP2 +0.6 ATR more, stair-step stop (ladder.by_expert.trend_stairs); sell when 2 of 3 sell indicators agree or the 1-hour trend turns. Levels from the 58-stock reversal study. Live at 0.5% risk (risk_by_expert). Set live to false to switch it off. 2026-10-17 refinement (58 stocks, last 3 months, two halves; nothing profitable): the candle/volume/volatility confirmation (3 of 5) was the only change better than the base in BOTH halves (PF 0.72 / 0.55 vs 0.68 / 0.42; daily -0.020% / -0.017% vs -0.047% / -0.046%) -> confirm 0.6 live. Daily lists (select) and the TP box (tp_zone) did not help in the second half -> off.

funnel._note: owner's Stock Funnel (pasted script 2026-10-17, rebuilt with its bugs fixed; alpacabot.funnel): daily bars, stage 2 longs / stage 4 shorts, 3 of 4 buy votes (at the 20-day MA not extended, above the 20-day VWAP, volume 1.2x, stochastic cross), stop at the Bollinger band kept 1-3 ATR away, take-profit 1.5R (both at Alpaca), sells on 2 of 3 (3 closes under the MA, under VWAP, stochastic turning down) or a stage change. Its own 3 slots at 0.5% risk. Set live to false to switch it off. 2026-10-17 check (55 stocks, daily): last 3 months 107 trades PF 0.80 - longs 67 +4.3R, shorts 40 -12.6R; last 12 months longs 281 +24.4R, shorts 152 -28.1R. Shorts lost in both windows (clearly harmful) -> shorts off (set shorts true to turn them back on); longs live.
